name: otp-change-by-admin
subject: Your telephone number for one-time passcodes has been updated
previewText: The requested change to your personal details has been confirmed

fields.heading: Your telephone number for one-time passcodes has been updated
fields.body:
Hello {user_first_name},

The telephone number used to send you one-time passcodes in relation to your Abundance account has been updated to a number ending in {phone_last_4_digits}.

If you did not request this change, please contact us immediately at support@abundanceinvestment.com or 020 3475 8666 so that we can ensure the safety of your account.
